title: Tooltips are shifted up when panel is vertical
line: Tooltips and popups of a side panel now open next to their icon when another panel or bar sits above it.
explanation: Panels are layer shell windows, and layer shell never tells a client where the compositor put its surface. plasmashell therefore guessed each panel's position, and popups and tooltips are placed from that position; for a side panel the guess was the top of the screen, while KWin lays it out below anything at the top that reserves space (a Plasma top panel or a third-party bar), so everything the side panel opened was shifted up by that height. KWin now sends layer shell surfaces their real position through a new org_kde_plasma_surface.position event (plasma-shell protocol version 9), libplasma's PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration keeps it and signals changes, and PanelView uses it instead of its guess, which stays only as a fallback (X11, older compositors).

commits.message:
plasma-shell: Add an event with the position of the surface

Clients can't know where the compositor puts layer shell surfaces, so
Plasma guesses where its panels are and places their popups from that
guess. Add an event that tells clients the real position of a surface.

CCBUG: 518087

plasmashell: Send layer shell surfaces their position

Plasma places panel popups and tooltips from where it thinks the panel
is, but only KWin knows where layer shell surfaces end up, for example
below other panels. Send them their position through the plasma surface.

CCBUG: 518087

PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration: Expose the compositor's position

Layer shell windows can't know their position, so popups and tooltips of
panels were placed from a guess. Keep the position the compositor sends
for the surface and tell the window's owner when it changes.

CCBUG: 518087

shell/panelview: Use the position the compositor sends for panels

Panels guessed their own position, and side panels assumed they started
at the top of the screen even below a top panel, so their tooltips and
popups opened shifted up by its height. Use the compositor's position.

BUG: 518087

patches.diff:
From 1a8d517205181fde2dbb076e6297dd74890f4527 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 02:18:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] plasma-shell: Add an event with the position of the surface

Clients can't know where the compositor puts layer shell surfaces, so
Plasma guesses where its panels are and places their popups from that
guess. Add an event that tells clients the real position of a surface.

CCBUG: 518087
---
 src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml | 15 +++++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 13 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
index baca1af..19be0a2 100644
--- a/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
+++ b/src/protocols/plasma-shell.xml
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
     SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later
   ]]></copyright>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_shell" version="9">
     <description summary="create shell windows and helpers">
       This interface is used by KF5 powered Wayland shells to communicate with
       the compositor and can only be bound one time.
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
     </request>
   </interface>
 
-  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="8">
+  <interface name="org_kde_plasma_surface" version="9">
     <description summary="metadata interface">
       An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for
       implementations that provide the shell user interface.
@@ -82,6 +82,17 @@
       <arg name="y" type="int" summary="y coordinate in global space"/>
     </request>
 
+    <event name="position" since="9">
+      <description summary="position of the surface">
+        Sent by the compositor with the position of the surface in global
+        coordinates, for surfaces it places itself, such as layer shell
+        surfaces, so that the client can place popups next to them. It is sent
+        when the surface is first placed and every time it moves.
+      </description>
+      <arg name="x" type="int" summary="x coordinate in global space"/>
+      <arg name="y" type="int" summary="y coordinate in global space"/>
+    </event>
+
     <!-- Role -->
 
     <enum name="role">
--

review.text: Strong, root-cause fix across plasma-wayland-protocols, kwin, libplasma, and plasma-workspace: adding org_kde_plasma_surface.position (v9) lets KWin report the real compositor-assigned position of layer-shell surfaces so PanelView no longer guesses its origin under other Plasma panels or third-party layer-shell bars. Resource version gating, backwards-compatible fallback on X11/older compositors, QObject/unique_ptr lifetimes, surfaceDestroyed reset, and binary compatibility in libplasma are all handled cleanly, and the screenshots and regression tests thoroughly prove the fix. (Minor non-blocking nits: KWin could skip sending duplicate position events on pure size changes, and KWin/libplasma will need their PlasmaWaylandProtocols minimum version bumped once the protocol release is tagged.)

reviews.text: Strong, root-cause fix across plasma-wayland-protocols, kwin, libplasma, and plasma-workspace: adding org_kde_plasma_surface.position (v9) lets KWin report the real compositor-assigned position of layer-shell surfaces so PanelView no longer guesses its origin under other Plasma panels or third-party layer-shell bars. Resource version gating, backwards-compatible fallback on X11/older compositors, QObject/unique_ptr lifetimes, surfaceDestroyed reset, and binary compatibility in libplasma are all handled cleanly, and the screenshots and regression tests thoroughly prove the fix. (Minor non-blocking nits: KWin could skip sending duplicate position events on pure size changes, and KWin/libplasma will need their PlasmaWaylandProtocols minimum version bumped once the protocol release is tagged.)

Correct diagnosis and the right layer: only KWin knows where a layer-shell surface lands, and a plasma-surface position event plus PanelView consuming it fixes tooltips, applet popups and the config dialog at the source; the before/after shots show the tooltip re-centred on the icon. The KWin, libplasma and plasma-workspace parts look sound (QPointer, version-gated send, reset on surface destroy, guess kept as fallback). But KWin and libplasma won't build against the currently required PlasmaWaylandProtocols, because ORG_KDE_PLASMA_SURFACE_POSITION_SINCE_VERSION and the overridden event don't exist in v8. PanelView now also creates an org_kde_plasma_surface for every panel, which sends set_role/skip_*/panel_takes_focus and sets _q_showWithoutActivating, and that side effect isn't mentioned or tested. Multi-monitor wasn't verified, even though positionPanel/restore now feed QWindow::setPosition a compositor position that can be stale for a moment after a screen or edge change.
changes: Bump the required PlasmaWaylandProtocols version in KWin and libplasma CMakeLists to the upcoming release that carries plasma-shell v9, as dependent MRs

Mention in the plasma-workspace commit that panels now get a plasma surface, and check that this (set_role normal, skip flags, _q_showWithoutActivating) doesn't change panel focus or Meta+Alt+P keyboard activation

Verify on two screens: move a panel between screens and rearrange or resize outputs, and confirm popups and tooltips land right with no wrong-screen placement from the stale position before the new event arrives
